answer: Sybil defense: each identity accumulates a sealed history shale of graded-work hashes. Voting weight accrues only when a fresh peer signal from a distinct social-graph cut co-attests that history. Clones that wander across cuts dilute co-attestation density; convex tenure weighting means n clones sharing stake S earn roughly 1/n the influence of one agent. An attacker must buy lasting trust inside each cut, not rent parallel keys.
